verdict.rationale: Clara claims its API offers 'programmatic control over every aspect' of spend management. The evidence backs this for cards (create, update, lock, delete, configuration restrictions), transactions and labels, users, invoices, Pix payments and webhook subscriptions, all exposed through a published OpenAPI schema and an MCP server. Several UI-facing features have no API evidence: expense reporting, approval workflows and Clara Intelligence insights or the CFO agent, so full UI parity rests only on the vendor's broad claim. missing for 10: API coverage of expense reports, approval workflows, and Clara Intelligence analytics, plus independent verification that UI and API are at parity.
